judgement.reason: Shaarli is a database-free bookmarking service whose bookmarks and settings live only in a local data directory, and Deployz provides no persistent disk.

evidence.quote: The personal, minimalist, super fast, database-free, bookmarking service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/www/shaarli/data (Dockerfile), volume shaarli-data:/var/www/shaarli/data (docker-compose.yml shaarli)
reviews.reason: Shaarli is a database-free bookmarking service that keeps its bookmarks and settings in /var/www/shaarli/data, and no shown setting moves that data to a managed datastore, so it needs durable disk that Deployz does not provide.
